title: Edge-TTS Voice Generation Example
description: Generates voiceover audio only using Microsoft Edge-TTS. No visuals, music, or render. Requires internet for first use (Edge-TTS connects to Microsoft servers).
script:
This is an example of voiceover generation using Edge-TTS.
You can choose from over four hundred voices in more than one hundred languages.
The voice is generated locally with no cloud API key needed.
